subject.title: fix(session-memory): forward hook config model to LLM slug generator

question: Should OpenClaw accept `hooks.internal.entries.session-memory.model` as the supported hook-level config contract for LLM slug generation?
rationale: The code path is narrow and reuses the embedded-runner model resolver, but it changes the meaning of a previously ignored passthrough key for existing users.

options.title: Accept hook model contract
options.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and merge once required checks remain green.

options.title: Require stronger upgrade docs
options.body: Ask for public docs or release-note context that explicitly calls out the newly consumed key and upgrade effect before merge.

options.title: Pause this config direction
options.body: Hold or close this PR if the permanent product direction is to avoid a session-memory hook-level model setting.

recommendation.title: Accept hook model contract
recommendation.body: Treat `session-memory.model` as intentional supported config and merge once required checks remain green.
